question: Keep VPD's subcomponents and replace the gate function by a neuron-style top-k gate (each subcomponent kept when its own inner activation |x . V_c| is among the k largest of its matrix's alive subcomponents at that position, read from the fine-tune's clean forward). Does the share's nine-pair separation fall to the neuron version's level?

settings.k_scales_source: the brief (lead, 2026-11-20): k per matrix matched to Gamma's mean count of gates above 0.5 per position at W0 (scale 1, scored), and half and double beside it. The matched k is E136's experiments/share_untrained/results/stage0.json .k_m (305,423 positions of every E136 pair's read rows), the same k the TopK neuron share's 'kmatched' used (experiments/holes_fill/run.py line 215), so the two top-k gates differ in the unit only. k at a scale: round(scale x k_m), at least 1, at most the matrix's alive count (topk_gate.scaled_k); at 0.5 the nine matrices with k_m 1 or 2 read k 1 (block 0's q, k, v, o; block 1's q, k; block 2's q; block 3's q, k), so the half arm is not half there
settings.projected_limit_min_source: E136 read its 68 states, the share plus two untrained decompositions, in about 5 min on a debug L40 (cluster/logs/commute-share-untrained-56944.out, 07:37 to 07:42); this run makes 2 clean and 10 masked forwards per batch against E136's about 1 and 4 (route_split plus its base), so about 2.5 times E136 per state: ~12 min for this run's 68 states; the limit is ~4 times that and under the debug QoS cap

thresholds.thresholds_source: reproduce_tol: the share re-read through the same calls differed from its saved value by 1.1e-5 and 1.2e-4 (E187 check b, experiments/size_matched/results/m67_pod.log) and by 0.0019 at most (E211, 0.7538 against 0.7519, as E228's reproduce_tol cites); 0.01 is E143's, E187's and E228's filed tolerance on the share, five times the largest measured re-read gap. The gamma gate here is the same calls (topk_gate.clean mirrors vpd.compute_ci with chunk = batch), so it should read the saved value to within ~1e-4. neuron_level: 'neurons for half the gain' kept six of the nine built pairs apart in the built direction, none reversed, three not apart (experiments/method_table/results/final.json .tally.built.k_half: 'same direction as the share' 6, 'no call' 3; the skeleton's 6/0/3). neuron_top_level: the TopK neuron share (the same top-k gate on MLP neurons) read four pairs the built way and five reversed (final.json .tally.built.neuron_top: same 4, opposite 5), reported beside P1, not scored

readings.share of a gate: mean over the read rows of (L01 - L00) over mean of (T1 - T0): T the target model's log-odds of the trained answer at the read position at W0 (T0) and at the fine-tune (T1); L the released subcomponents (Delta out) masked by the gate read from W0's clean forward (L00) or the fine-tune's (L01). Not read (nan) when the gain is under MIN_GAIN = 1 log-odds (local_faith.MIN_GAIN)
readings.gates: gamma: Gamma's causal importances (the saved share's own masks, the positive control); gamma_bin: gamma above 0.5 as 1, else 0 (reported); topk_x0.5, topk_x1, topk_x2: the top-k gate at k = scale x k_m (topk_x1 scored)
readings.inner activation: x . V_c, param-decomp's LinearComponents.get_component_acts (pinned 74146b5) on the matrix's cached input in the clean forward, fp32; candidates are round 1's alive subcomponents (experiments/transport_test/results/large/alive.pt, mean causal importance over 1e-6)

P0 (stops).rule: exit 1 unless: (a) first and alone, a zero change on the first state's rows reads the gain, every gate's numerator and every per-row L01 - L00 exactly 0 (all shares then nan); (b) per state, the gamma gate's share is within reproduce_tol of the saved scorecard share (experiments/share_untrained/results/stage1.json .states[s].trained, or experiments/refit_96key/results/stage1.json .states[s].e136.trained for the e58 states)
P0 (stops).blind_to: whether the top-k gate is a fair stand-in for Gamma; (a) checks that the cells are differences of identical forwards; (b) checks the rows, the batches, the state files and that the new path equals the saved share's calls
P0 (stops).positive_control: (b): through the same new code path, Gamma's own masks must give the saved share on every state

pair call.rule: per gate and pair, the scorecard's one rule (E133, cell P2.23, method_table): 'built' if every reuse-side share is above every new-side share (strictly), 'reversed' if every one is below, 'not apart' otherwise; 'not read' if any share on either side is not finite (gain under MIN_GAIN, or a missing state)
pair call.edge_cases: ties (equal values across sides) are 'not apart'; a zero change everywhere (every numerator 0) gives equal shares of 0 and 'not apart' on every pair; a pair whose states are all nan is 'not read'; the shared sides (e54_matched and e54_own share the reuse side, open_pair_c3 and open_pair_c3_copy the new side) are read once and used in both pairs

P1 (filed).rule: on the topk_x1 gate: 'no call' if any of the nine pairs is 'not read'; else 'falls to the neuron level' if the number of pairs called 'built' is at most neuron_level (6), 'holds above' if it is 7, 8 or 9
P1 (filed).edge_cases: all nan: 'no call'; the do-nothing state (every share nan) reads 'no call', not a pass; a top-k gate whose sets never move (every numerator 0) reads 0 'built' and so 'falls': a real outcome (the share then comes from Gamma's graded values, not from which subcomponents are on); 9 'built' with 0 reversed is the share's own reading
P1 (filed).beside_it: the count against neuron_top_level (4) and the tally of every other gate (gamma must read 9 built, as the scorecard; gamma_bin, topk_x0.5, topk_x2 reported)

expected.zero change: gain 0, every numerator 0, every share nan, exactly
expected.gamma: the saved share on every state to within ~1e-4 (the same calls); tally 9 built, 0 reversed
expected.topk_x1: filed: at most 6 of 9 pairs 'built' (P1 'falls to the neuron level')
expected.gamma_bin, topk_x0.5, topk_x2: no filed value; reported to read P1: a fall under gamma_bin too says binarising alone costs the separation; topk_x1 between gamma_bin and the neuron count says the choice of subcomponents matters

blind_to: a top-k gate that is per position and local (Gamma reads the whole row, bidirectionally), so a fall may come from locality as well as from 'activation, not importance'; the inner activation ignores |U_c| (VPD's U, V scale is not normalised), a choice named in the plan; k matched on E136's rows at W0 only, not per task; the shares of a gate are read at the saved update size, not size-matched
items: the 68 saved fine-tunes of E187's nine built pairs (experiments/size_matched/run.py BUILT, pairs()), each read once with five gates; the 9 pair calls per gate
